description: This file defines a set of API functions for interacting with a backend server. It includes methods for HTTP GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE requests, as well as specific functions for managing work items and comments, with logic for handling Authorization headers and localStorage integration.

methods.name: withAuthHeaders(extra = {})
methods.description: Builds headers with Authorization if token is available from getAuthHeaderValue.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request with proper headers and parses JSON response.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body and parses JSON response.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters and parses JSON response.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON body and parses JSON response.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item via GET request.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, sourcing author_id from localStorage if not provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items, optionally filtered by projectId.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, sourcing created_by from localStorage's auth user displayName.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a work item via PATCH request.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for a given API path.
